read.thesis: Aluminum realised price rose to $3,749/t in 4Q25 from $3,374 in 3Q25 and Adjusted EBITDA reached $546M, but 2026 guidance is for production of 2.4–2.6Mt, up on smelter restarts, with Q1 EBITDA guided down $100M sequentially.

utilisation.quote: In the Aluminum segment, production increased 4 percent sequentially to 604,000 metric tons primarily due to progress on the San Ciprián, Spain smelter restart.

triggers.label: Smelter restarts lift 2026 output
triggers.quote: Alcoa expects 2026 total Aluminum segment production to range between 2.4 and 2.6 million metric tons, an increase from 2025 due to smelter restarts.

guidance.quote: Alcoa expects 2026 total Alumina segment production to range between 9.7 and 9.9 million metric tons
Alcoa expects 2026 total Aluminum segment production to range between 2.4 and 2.6 million metric tons
In 2026, aluminum shipments are expected to range between 2.6 and 2.8 million metric tons.
In 2026, alumina shipments are expected to be between 11.8 and 12.0 million metric tons.
the Company expects sequential unfavorable impacts of $30 million due to the typical first quarter impacts
Alcoa expects sequential unfavorable impacts of $70 million due to the absence of Spain and Norway carbon dioxide compensation
Alcoa expects first quarter 2026 operational tax expense to approximate $65 million to $75 million
